title: Screen coupled five-chart nonmonotone owned contacts (no new κ)
body:
One joint five-choice nonmonotone contact model returns the unchanged complete paid/helper profile. Each round-three chart can choose any preimage of a subspace of the quotient on binary axes 1 and 2. This extends PR5144's binary alphabet while retaining all main endpoints, common scalar contacts, 408 independent helper jobs, eight fully paid centers, every transport bridge and 72 shared late native maps with their 12 prelude line constraints.

The optional SciPy MILP has 9,652 contact variables and 384,525 total variables. One 180-second-capped solve reports numerical optimality after 43.321 seconds; its returned one-contact change has exactly the source histograms under integer reassessment. This supplies no exact optimality certificate, native word or higher κ. The next decision is to change the mechanism rather than run an axis-pair census.

Validation: registered normal and optimized Python 3.12 checks pass, including literal source bill reconstruction, 4,429 independently enumerated quotient-domain controls, all changed center charges and eight rejection controls. Committed package/input bytes pass preflight. No signed native/endpoint, selected cold replay, compiler/outer or Lean replay was run for a changed construction. Frozen predecessors and selected κ=.00302015 remain untouched.

Credit Cao Yifan/intqwq, Dugongue, Cinna Davis/1337isnot1337, Matarener, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and retained native/helper/compiler lineage. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4611#discussioncomment-19145731 .
